critical_code_review_comments: SquadDetail.jsx uses two different testid schemes: squad-pool-row-${testKey}/squad-pool-pick-${testKey} (derived from player_no/testKey) vs squad-member-${player_id} (UUID). This inconsistency makes end-to-end Playwright verification harder — recommend standardising on player_id everywhere OR expose both attrs (data-player-id + data-player-no) on every row.

selection_console.py lines 382-398: /pending-actions/mpca reuses per-tournament resolver in a loop with 'break' — early break may hide tournaments whose only actionable item is not squad_pick (e.g. closure_letter). Consider paginating by tournament instead of item count.

TournamentStatusStepper mounts on TournamentDetail — ensure it hides on Cancelled tournaments if that status is possible; currently only 6 statuses in stepper (spec says Draft→…→Completed, which is fine).
